title: a guard file with jitso's marker and other content is upgraded to what this binary generates
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. A file whose first line is jitso's generated marker is jitso's: when its content is not what this binary generates (an older version, another command), setup hook backs it up and rewrites it, showing the diff, with no --force.

files..pi/extensions/jitso-guard.js:
// generated by jitso v0.0.1: jitso setup hook; do not edit
export default function (pi) {}

stdout: -// generated by jitso v0.0.1: jitso setup hook; do not edit

regex: ^// generated by jitso \S+: jitso setup hook; do not edit
